Welcome to Godwin Primary School!
Welcome to our website. We are a busy, friendly school, with lots going on throughout the year. We aim to provide a warm, inclusive environment where every child feels valued and supported.
This website is designed to give you a taster of life at our school, as well as provide regularly updated information for both parents and pupils.
We hope you enjoy exploring our site and find everything you're looking for. If you have any questions or need further information, please do not hesitate to contact the school office directly.
Thank you for visiting!
Need a paper copy? If you require a printed version of any information found on our website, please contact the school office and we will be happy to assist.
Our School Vision

This is underpinned by the Godwin Values and Core Aim.
Welcome to Godwin Primary School!

Breakfast Club
Start your day the right way at our Breakfast Club, opening at 7:30am.
Our Breakfast Club provides children with flexible opportunities for play, relaxation, and engaging activities in a cooperative and supportive environment. We place a strong emphasis on leisure, ensuring that children do not view the club as an extension of their school day but as a calm and enjoyable start to their morning. Children are also offered a variety of breakfast options to help them begin the day feeling nourished and ready to learn.
The Club is led by Mrs. Wilkins and Miss Brand.
Management is overseen by a committee made up of the two lead staff, the School Business Manager, and the Welfare for Learning Lead (Mr. Wilding).
If you would like to use our facilities:
1. Make sure that you are familiar with the information in this booklet.
2. Complete a registration form (one per child). Forms are available from the school office and can be requested by phone or email.
3. Sign up for your chosen sessions at the Club by completing a booking form below.
4 . Add your payment to ParentPay by Friday at 12:30pm.
The 1st day of any term should be booked on the last day of the previous term. The expectation for this is the 1st day in September, which can be booked either the 2 days before the Autumn term via the school office.

After School Club – Premier Education
We are pleased to announce that Premier Education will be providing after-school provision for children in Reception through to Year 6, starting on Monday 19th January 2026.
This is an externally provided service, and all bookings must be made directly with Premier Education.
Please find below the brochure and further information about the provision, including details of activities, session times, and booking arrangements.
The simplest way to book your child is to book online by following the steps below:
Visit www.premier-education.com
Click on ‘Book a course’
In the ‘Location’ box, type in your school’s postcode and click ‘Search’
Select your venue and click the Wraparound Care option
Select the session and day you would like to book
Register your details or log in if you are a returning customer
Follow the booking process and select ‘Card’ in the Payment Method section to complete your booking
Once your booking is complete, you will receive an email confirmation
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact the school office.

The Governing Board has an important part to play in raising school standards through its three key roles:
- Setting strategic direction - Ensuring accountability - Monitoring and evaluating school performance
The Governing Board meets twice a term as a whole group - for a Full Governing Board meeting and a strategy meeting. There are two additional, smaller committees which also meet at least termly: - Operations Committee - Teaching and Learning Committee
Through all of these meetings, Governors oversee the running of the school and hold the Headteacher and staff to account. Governors are responsible for ensuring the school is run efficiently and legally.
All governors are asked to complete a declaration of pecuniary and related business interests. The register is reviewed annually and Governors sign an up to date declaration. The attached document shows any business interests declared by the Governors, their terms of office and their attendance at Full Governing Body and committee meetings.
For further information about Godwin's Governors, see below.
The Department for Education encourages schools to collect governing board members' data to evaluate the boards diversity. We are pleased to report that we use the DfE recommended toolkit to collect protected characteristics of our board member.
To ensure that individuals cannot be identified we do not publish this data on our website.

pageCache.text:
Support for Parents
Hello, my name is Mrs Crudgington. I am the Parent Liaison and Safeguarding Manager at Godwin Primary School, and I have over 25 years of experience working with children and families.
You will find me at the front gate every morning, ready to welcome you into school, and at the back gate each afternoon to wish you a good evening.
My primary responsibility is to keep our children safe and to support families in any way I can. This may include offering guidance and advice on a range of issues, signposting to community resources, or working with parents/carers to navigate challenges or concerns they may face.
I look forward to meeting you and working together to ensure your child receives the support they need to grow and thrive both academically and socially.

After School activity clubs
We are excited to announce our fantastic range of after-school sports clubs at Godwin Primary School for the Spring Term! The clubs will run from April- July.
Our after-school clubs are a wonderful opportunity for children to:
Stay active and healthy
Build confidence and teamwork skills
Learn and develop new sporting skills
Have fun in a positive, supportive environment
Summer Term Club Timetable
Tuesday
Year 4, 5 & 6 – Gymnastics Club 3:30 – 4:30pm £30
Thursday
Year 3 & 4 – Football Club 15th January – 26th March 3:30 – 4:30pm £30
Friday
Year 1 & 2 – Football Club 3:20 – 4:20pm £27
All sessions are led by qualified and experienced coaches who are passionate about helping children enjoy sport while developing skills, confidence, and a love of being active.
⚽🏀 Places are limited and will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis, so we encourage you to book early to avoid missing out!
👉 To book, please visit: www.parentpay.com
We look forward to welcoming the children to another exciting and active term of sport.
